_about: Labelled lines for scripts/commitments/eval-judge.ts. real/junk/unresolved/ambiguous are single caller lines; context (pronouns, run-ons) and tails (a plan, then a goodbye) are short calls with the commitments expected, each as the words its statement must contain (any one of each group). Sources: #1896 fixture (stances moved to junk, lines about Ferni or with an unnamed pronoun moved out of real), the #1896 verifier's writer.tsv/table2/probe2. heldoutReal/heldoutJunk were written after the prompt's examples were fixed and share none of them; the prompt's examples are in no set. adversarial: the #1985 verifier's 40 cases (R pronouns/retractions, J junk, A injections and edge cases, from its cases.json) plus H01-H08 injections written after the guard and prompt were fixed; expect 'store' or 'none', must = word groups a stored statement needs, mustNot = words no stored statement may contain; inject marks prompt-injection attempts.
